text: NHE6 expression was selectively down-regulated in ε4 (ApoE4) vs ApoE3 astrocytes, and the paper presents this as the cause of the pathological endosome acidification.
description: ApoE4 vs ApoE3 astrocytes; source and species not given in the abstract (abstract-only). Caveat: an intermediate step; possibly not human astrocytes.

provenance.excerpt: Pathological endosome acidification is caused by ε4 risk allele-selective down-regulation of the Na<sup>+</sup>/H<sup>+</sup> exchanger isoform NHE6, which functions as a critical leak pathway for endosomal protons.

meccogFinding.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (lower NHE6 expression) -> (reduced endosomal proton leak) -> (lower endosomal pH in astrocytes)

perturbed.variable: ε4 vs ε3 allele in astrocytes

measured.variable: NHE6 (SLC9A6) expression, proposed endosomal proton leak pathway
